name: dataarcus-powerbi
description: Design and check Power BI reports on your own model from VS Code's chat: the DataArcus MCP server, bundled. Runs on your computer; no telemetry.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: DataArcus reads the Power BI projects in your folder and writes new reports beside them: it runs only in a folder you trust.

dataarcus.workingFolder.markdownDescription: The folder DataArcus reads and writes in (`DATAARCUS_ROOT`): the folder that holds your `.pbip` projects. Empty: the first folder open in VS Code. A relative path is inside that folder. DataArcus never reads or writes outside it.

dataarcus.nodePath.markdownDescription: The Node.js program (20.10 or later) that runs the DataArcus server. Empty: VS Code's own runtime, so nothing else has to be installed.
